findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: lookup_vendor, search_vendors, notice_windows, upcoming_model_retirements · Private data: lookup_vendor, search_vendors · Public sink: upcoming_model_retirements.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: lookup_vendor, search_vendors, notice_windows, upcoming_model_retirements · Private data: lookup_vendor, search_vendors · Public sink: upcoming_model_retirements

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
